name: Arturo Merino Benítez International Airport

runway.v: two runways; the longest is 17R/35L, 3,800 m long and 45 m wide (17L/35R is 3,750 m × 55 m)

hours.v: aerodrome and air traffic services open 24 hours

handling.v: handling on request from the handling companies
handling.quote: A requerimiento a las Empresas de Handling

notes: Customs hours are not stated as hours in AD 2.3, only the 2-hour request rule, so customs.h24 is left unset. AD 2.3 also says: 'Operadores Aéreos deberán informar al SAG con 12 horas de antelación al arribo de su aeronave' (agriculture/livestock service must be told 12 hours before arrival). AD 2.8: 'La DGAC no dispone de estacionamientos para larga estadía' (no long-stay parking from DGAC; category C or larger aircraft staying over 24 hours use aprons run by third parties - paraphrase, not quoted). The AIP mentions an 'FBO Santiago' hangar only in helicopter routing. The web reader stopped at page AD 2 SCEL-25 (AD 2.20); AD 2.21 noise and any night rules were not read. The Vol I AD index (checked 29 Oct 2026) lists this same file; pages AD 2.12 onward are AMDT 67, effective 06 Aug 2026. AIP lists DGAC as administration; the Nuevo Pudahuel concession was not checked.
